title: TagInput
description: Free-form tag entry with suggestions: Enter, the add button or blur add the draft, arrow keys pick a suggestion, and IME composition never commits.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the clear button

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable and selectable, but the text cannot be edited

props.name: invalid
props.description: Error state: danger border (`aria-invalid` on the web)

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the field; a string label is also the field's accessible name (unless `accessibilityLabel` is set)

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content before the text, e.g. an icon or "@"

props.name: suffix
props.description: Content after the text, e.g. a unit or a button

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value (not when disabled or read-only). Clearing calls `onChange("")` and `onClear`

props.name: type
props.description: `password` hides the text and shows a visibility toggle

props.name: showPasswordLabel
props.description: Label of the visibility toggle while hidden

props.name: hidePasswordLabel
props.description: Label of the visibility toggle while visible

props.name: showCharCount
props.description: Shows the number of characters (and `maxLength`, when set) after the text

props.name: wrapperStyle
props.description: Style of the frame around the text

events.name: onClear
events.description: Called after the clear button emptied the field

vars.name: --tag-input-gap
vars.description: Space between the tags and between the tags and the entry row

vars.name: --tag-input-tag-min-height
vars.description: Minimum height of a tag (defaults to the density's small control height)

vars.name: --tag-input-list-max-height
vars.description: Maximum height of the suggestion list before it scrolls

vars.name: --tag-input-list-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the suggestion list (defaults to --radius-md)

vars.name: --tag-input-option-padding-y
vars.description: Vertical padding of a suggestion (follows the density's row padding)

vars.name: --tag-input-option-padding-x
vars.description: Horizontal padding of a suggestion (follows the density's row padding)

form-control.title: Forms
form-control.description: name submits each tag as a hidden input; FormField provides the label and read-only state.

separators.title: Separators
separators.description: separators lists the strings that split typed or pasted text into tags; "Enter" commits on the Enter key and splits pasted lines.

TagInputProps.value: Selected tags (controlled); omit for an uncontrolled field
TagInputProps.defaultValue: Initial tags of an uncontrolled field
TagInputProps.onChange: Called with the next tags after an addition, a removal or clearing
TagInputProps.options: Suggestions; already selected tags are hidden and duplicates merged
TagInputProps.commitOnBlur: Adds the typed draft as a tag when the input loses focus
TagInputProps.separators: Keys that commit the draft: a literal string (e.g. "," or ";") splits the typed or pasted text into tags; "Enter" commits on the Enter key (and also splits pasted text on line breaks)
TagInputProps.id: Id of the text input (defaults to the FormControl id)
TagInputProps.name: Submits every selected tag under this name (hidden inputs); the draft is not submitted
TagInputProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the text input when there is no FormControl label
TagInputProps.aria-labelledby: Ids of the elements labelling the text input (wins over the FormControl label)
TagInputProps.aria-describedby: Extra ids describing the text input
TagInputProps.disabled: Disables the field (also set by FormControl)
TagInputProps.readOnly: Shows the tags without editing controls (also set by FormControl)
TagInputProps.invalid: Error state (also set by an invalid FormControl)
TagInputProps.emptyText: Text of the suggestion list when nothing matches
TagInputProps.addLabel: Accessible label of the add button
TagInputProps.clearLabel: Accessible label of the clear button
TagInputProps.removeLabel: Accessible label of a tag's remove button
TagInputProps.createLabel: Text of the "create this tag" suggestion

cssVars.--tag-input-gap: Space between the tags and between the tags and the entry row
cssVars.--tag-input-tag-min-height: Minimum height of a tag (defaults to the density's small control height)
cssVars.--tag-input-list-max-height: Maximum height of the suggestion list before it scrolls
cssVars.--tag-input-list-radius: Corner radius of the suggestion list (defaults to --radius-md)
cssVars.--tag-input-option-padding-y: Vertical padding of a suggestion (follows the density's row padding)
cssVars.--tag-input-option-padding-x: Horizontal padding of a suggestion (follows the density's row padding)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Type a tag and press Enter, or pick a suggestion with the arrow keys. value is a property; minerva-change reports each new list.

separators.title: Separators
separators.description: separators=", ; Enter" splits typed or pasted text into tags. With no-commit-on-blur, leaving the field keeps the draft as text.

states.title: Sizes and states
states.description: Three sizes, invalid, readonly (tags shown without editing controls, still submitted) and disabled.

form.title: In a form
form.description: The element is form-associated: each tag is submitted as its own entry under name, required rejects an empty list and Reset restores the value attribute.

props.noCommitOnBlur: Does not add the typed draft as a tag when the field loses focus.
props.readOnly: Shows the tags without editing controls; they are still submitted.
props.required: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message describing the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.minerva-change: The tags changed (addition, removal, clearing); detail: { value }.
events.minerva-input: The typed text (draft) changed; detail: { value } is the draft.
events.minerva-open-change: The suggestion list is about to open or close (detail: { open }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
events.minerva-clear: The clear button removed every tag.

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the add and clear buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the add and clear buttons on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed icon button.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of a pressed icon button.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the add and clear buttons (defaults follow the density's control heights).
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the button icons.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the add and clear buttons (defaults to --radius-lg).
cssVars.--input-height: Minimum height of the text field (defaults to the density's control height of the size).
cssVars.--input-radius: Corner radius of the text field (defaults to --radius-lg).
cssVars.--input-font-size: Font size of the text field.
cssVars.--input-background: Background color of the text field.
cssVars.--input-border-color: Border color of the text field at rest.
cssVars.--input-focus-color: Border color of the text field while hovered or focused.
cssVars.--tag-height: Minimum height of a tag (default: the content height).
cssVars.--tag-radius: Corner radius of a tag (defaults to --radius-sm).
cssVars.--tag-gap: Space between a tag's label and its remove button.
cssVars.--tag-ring-color: Color of the hairline ring of the tinted tags (defaults to the text color at 16%).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with "".
methods.formResetCallback: Form-associated callback called by form.reset(): restores the default value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form-associated callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form-associated callback called when the browser restores the value (back navigation, autofill).
